title: Freight requests
lead: Goods customers want moved: check the AI's estimate against the photos, then send the firm quote.
confirmClose: Close this request? An open quote is withdrawn.

quote.title: Send a firm quote
quote.hint: Starts from the high end of the estimate: check it against the photos and a carrier where needed. It replaces any open quote.
quote.restsOnHint: When the customer accepts, that carrier gets the shipment at that price. The shipping you charge is yours to set.
quote.noCarrier: No carrier price chosen: staff assign a carrier when the shipment is packed.

carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.lead: Routes that can move this cargo, and carriers asked for their price. Prices here are what carriers charge Tracecart: never shown to the customer.
carriers.noRoutes: No active carrier route serves this request.
carriers.whatTheySeeHint: The goods as you describe them, the two cities and the ready date. Never the customer's name, phone, address, declared value or our prices.
carriers.descriptionHint: Check it against the photos. No names or phone numbers.
carriers.ask: {count, plural, =0 {Choose routes to ask} one {Ask # carrier} other {Ask # carriers}}
